this is not a BED file, you need to convert this BED12 format or find an equivalent version in BED12 format. You can search the forum for similar issues like GFF to BED conversion. I don't know any good tool that can do this, but that doesn't mean there isn't any. Please read about bed and GFF formats. 

Best,
